states: Mock estate with 19 active alerts (2 critical, 17 warning) and notification delivery not activated. Before: each alert was a tinted card with five buttons and a repeated "Notification delivery not turned on" line, a three-row stats table sat above, 3 alerts fit at 1440x900. After: one paused-delivery banner with overview wording, a Set up where alerts go link and Turn on delivery; no per-row global delivery line; a summary line (2 critical, 17 warning, Triggered (24h) 19); 5 alerts above the fold.

Rows keep resource name, (type), severity badge, node and a relative start age with the full localized start time on hover; meta line (limit, alert-specific delivery holds, snooze expiry) only when present.
German locale: banner, summary, buttons (Bestaetigen, Zurueckstellen, Mehr) and relative age (vor 20 Min.) all localized.
Notifications tab still shows the paused banner through the shared hook with its destinations wording; the banner title colour is now readable (was text-amber-900/25).
Phone 390x844 dark: banner stacks, summary wraps under the heading, row actions wrap to two lines, More reveals Timeline and Monitoring.
interactions: Clicked More on the first alert: Timeline and Monitoring appeared and the control read Less with aria-expanded true.
Clicked Timeline: the incident timeline loaded with filters and note box; Hide Timeline closed it while the disclosure stayed open; unit test covers Less closing an open timeline.
Repeated the More and Timeline interactions at phone width in dark mode; no page errors.
